ledger.x: About 700: the Katyuri principality of Kurmanchal.

ledger.cp: petty chieftaincies of Kumaon and Doti

ledger.x: 1563: the capital moves from Champawat to Almora.
Reign of Baz Bahadur Chand (1638-1678): bridging, page silent on the year.
October 1665: the Mughals capture the Terai.
October 1673: bridging, page silent on the Terai.
1742: the Rohillas annex parganas of the Terai.
1791: the Kingdom of Nepal conquers Kumaon.

wars.name: Mughal conquest of the Terai
wars.outcome: The Mughal army was sent to Kumaon in 1665 and Aurangzeb's army captured the Terai in October 1665; Baz Bahadur Chand was pardoned in October 1673.

wars.name: Baz Bahadur Chand at Taklakot
wars.outcome: "He captured the Fort of Taklakot" in Tibet in 1670; the page gives no tenure of it.

wars.name: Gyan Chand against Garhwal
wars.outcome: "In 1699 he invaded Garhwal"; the page gives no result and the Garhwal Kingdom page is silent on it.

wars.name: Rohilla invasion of Kumaon
wars.outcome: "In 1742 Ali Mohammed Khan of Rohilkhand invaded Kumaon" and annexed several parganas, including Kashipur and Rudrapur.

wars.name: Gorkha conquest of Kumaon
wars.outcome: "in 1791 the Kingdom of Nepal invaded Kumaon" from Doti and conquered it; Kumaon passed to the British after the Treaty of Sugauli.

certainty.note: The page names two seats and gives no boundary; the core is two circles.
The page gives no area or boundary; the shapes are the Uttarakhand hills east of 79.35 E, Doti as a circle and the Terai as a polygon cut.
